Increase 6000 points of magic attack, 15% attack bonus, cost 580 mana

Witcher.text: Base single-target healing skill, 20 yards of effective range, cost 2% mana.
Witcher.name: Healing Wave

Witcher.text: Continuous single-target healing skill, 20 yards of effective range, 1.5 seconds of channeling time, continuous healing for 18 seconds. 6x healing effect of Healing Wave, 20 yards of effective range, cost 6% mana.
Witcher.name: Healing Surge

Witcher.text: Summon a totem at your location for 15 seconds. The totem heals some HP for 1 wounded team or party member within 25 yards every 2 seconds. 1 minute CD. Cost 8% mana.
Witcher.name: Healing Fountain Totem

Witcher.text: 2 seconds of channeling time, heal HP for 1 ally within 12 yards, then the healing effect jumps to the team or party member with the least HP every 2 seconds. The healing effect is reduced by 30% with each jump. A total of 4 targets can be healed. 12 yards of effective range, 8 yards of healing effect jump range, cost 5% mana.
Witcher.name: Healing Chain

Witcher.text: Summon a totem at your location for 10 seconds. The totem heals some HP for all team or party members within 20 yards every 2 seconds. 2 minutes CD, cost 16% mana.
Witcher.name: Healing Tide Totem

Witcher.text: Resurrect 1 target within 5 yards, the resurrected target will have 60% HP and 15% MP. 10 minutes CD, cost 60% mana.
Witcher.name: Soul Returnal

Witcher.text: 15 yards of effective range, remove all magic debuffs and curse debuffs from 1 ally, or remove 1 buff from 1 enemy, cost 1% mana.
Witcher.name: Soul Purify

Witcher.text: Summon a spirit to protect you, reduce 30% of all damage taken for 15 seconds. 40 seconds CD, not affected by global CD, cost 1% mana.
Witcher.name: Summon Spirit

Witcher.text: Summon hands of the undead from underground to decrease 50% movement speed and 20% attack speed of the enemy for 8 seconds, 30 seconds CD, cost 1% mana.
Witcher.name: Undead Grip

Witcher.text: Remove and gain immunity to Knock-Outed and Fire-Trapped effects for 10 seconds. 30 seconds CD, not affected by global CD, cost 1% mana.
Witcher.name: Break the Chain

Witcher.text: Harden your skin, reduce 40% of all damage taken, as well as remove and gain immunity to Silenced effect for 8 seconds, 30 seconds CD, cost 1% mana.
Witcher.name: Undying Resolve

Witcher.text: Summon a totem at your location for 30 seconds. The totem increases 100% magic accuracy on all allies within 20 yards for 2.5 seconds every 2 seconds. 2 minutes CD, cost 2% mana.
Witcher.name: Spiritual Totem

Witcher.text: Summon undeads to ensnare all enemies within 15 yards and reduce 50% critical hit resist of the targets for 30 seconds, 2 minutes CD, cost 2% mana.
Witcher.name: Undead Ensnare
Witcher.when: all enemies within 15 yards lose 50% crit resist
